Building Flood-Resilient Communities Through Simple, Sustainable Innovation 📷📷

Manila Water’s Project i‑Float gained global recognition after being featured at the IAHR World Congress and SIWW 2025. Using floating bar screens to trap waste in waterways, the project has helped protect over 180,000 residents from flooding and improved treatment plant performance.

A practical solution creating real impact, and soon to expand across more flood‑prone areas in Metro Manila.
Together, we’re building flood‑resilient communities—one waterway at a time.

#SerbisyongKatubig #Sustainability #MWCInnovationSpotlight
